card.name: Verbs in advice to check or be careful
card.fires_on: The verb or adverb right after an instruction to patients, such as "always check", "watch for", or "CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERCISED". It fires on the action word in warning-style directives.

modes.label: Patient instruction verbs
modes.description: The verb or "always" after "advise/instruct patients to", before checking labels or watching for symptoms.
modes.example: Advise patients to always<< check>> the product label before each injection to confirm

modes.label: Caution should be exercised
modes.description: The ending of EXERCISED in all-caps caution statements before "when administering" or "when given".
modes.example: CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERC<<ISED>> WHEN ADMINISTERING PROMETHAZINE

card.plain: It marks the action word in warnings that tell patients or clinicians to check, watch, or take care.
